# When Goal-Oriented Error Warnings Agree

This repository contains a reproducible, scope-limited computational comparison of relative-entropy and information-weighted warning diagnostics in nonlinear ecological dynamics.

## Build

This article uses the [Computo Python template](https://github.com/computorg/template-computo-python). Install Quarto and its Computo extension before running `quarto render`. The article is a working submission candidate and has **not yet passed an official Computo build**.

## Data and code

See [README.md](README.md), [DATA_PROVENANCE_AND_LICENSE.md](DATA_PROVENANCE_AND_LICENSE.md), and [RELEASE_GATE.md](RELEASE_GATE.md).
